the pineal gland does not appear to be involved in the regulation of diurnal fluctuations in brain estrogen receptors in female rodents.

the diurnal variation in levels of cytosolic estrogen receptors is not a function of the pineal gland and is probably not a direct function of light-dark changes in the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis.
